name: Base-tile terrain palette
status: Applied to Road to Alderbrook through terrain color materials; source artwork and transparency are preserved
intent: Use the reference grass green as the main open-ground color. Keep a related natural landscape palette with deep shaded woods, warmer lighter fruit-tree foliage, and richer material accents.

families.label: Open ground
families.character: Reference grass green; main color sampled from the tile

families.label: Woods
families.character: Deeper forest greens; cooler and darker than open ground
families.assets: Woodland crowns, woods tiles and woodland cover

families.label: Orchard foliage
families.character: Warmer olive foliage; brighter fruit-tree highlights
families.assets: Fruit-tree foliage; fruit and blossoms use accent colors

families.label: Fruit and blossoms
families.character: Crimson apples, amber pears, pale blossoms

families.label: Wheat fields
families.assets: Continuous wheat stands and field tiles

families.label: Green crop fields
families.character: Fresh leafy greens related to the reference grass
families.assets: Continuous green crop stands and field tiles

families.label: Stubble fields
families.character: Dry ochre, cut straw and earthy shadows

families.label: Ploughed soil
families.character: Rich umber and warm terracotta earth
families.assets: Ploughed field tiles and visible soil

families.label: Dirt roads
families.character: Warm sandstone; lighter than surrounding soil
families.assets: Curved road and legacy road tiles

families.label: Timber and bridges
families.character: Weathered chestnut and honey wood grain
families.assets: Wooden buildings, wooden roofs and bridges

families.label: Stone buildings and walls
families.character: Cool stone shadows; warm limestone light

families.label: Slate roofs
families.character: Blue-grey slate; clear separation from timber

families.label: Hedges
families.character: Dense leaf greens with restrained warm highlights

families.label: Grid and fog overlay
families.character: Quiet neutral colors supporting terrain readability
families.assets: Existing hex outlines and fog tint; keep current transparency

reference.sampling: Median RGB of opaque green pixels in the central third of the tile
